claim_boundary: Infrastructure recovery for the preregistered matched fixed-60 control; no method comparison is valid until all three controls and the fail-closed audit complete.
root_cause: The original job 10399 embedded EXCLUDE_LINEAR_REGEX=score|classifier in unquoted shell text, so the shell attempted to execute classifier.
The first corrected wrappers inherited an NFS SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR that ece-nebula12 cannot mount.
The first local-directory wrapper did not pin the node-local Hugging Face cache and failed before training while resolving GLUE.
repairs: Pass the regex through sbatch --export instead of executable shell text.
Override SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR inside the wrapper before executing the training script.
Pin HF_HOME and HF_DATASETS_CACHE to the verified node-local cache and enable offline dataset/model loading.
Parameterize fixed-control job IDs in the audit and stage the audit outside the training checkout.
